text:
elaine-sales: Quick question — Acme AI (POC) pushed a counter-signed MSA with a redline requesting Net60 instead of Net45 and they want signer mapping across subsidiaries. I need to route the order form and confirm who can sign for billing/legal. I can share the draft order form: https://drive.google.com/example-orderform. Anyone from legal/finance available?

morgan-legal: Can you get the exact legal entity name on the PO and the proposed signer? Also we need the executed DPA scope before finalizing. Net60 is possible but requires finance credit approval. If the signer is a subsidiary, we need a delegation / corporate resolution or parent guarantee.

kai-ops: For e-sign: we use DocuSign enterprise envelopes. If they want different signers for order form vs MSA (subsidiary vs parent), we either send separate envelopes or add multiple signer roles. That increases the audit surface and sometimes breaks single-invoice workflows — ops prefers one signer per legal entity.

jordan-finance: Net60 can be approved subject to credit check. Per policy, extended terms may trigger a 2% fee if credit is borderline. Need billing contact, EIN, and remit-to address. cc: @amber-credit to run checks.

amber-credit: Started a soft credit pull; waiting on EIN and last 12 months purchase volume to clear. If credit profile is okay we'll approve Net60, otherwise fallback to Net30 with holdback.

elaine-sales: Attached order form draft: https://drive.google.com/example-orderform_v3.pdf. They proposed signer as 'Acme Health LLC' (a subsidiary), but they want a single invoice consolidated to Acme Inc. Also legal redlined SLA: uptime from 99.9 -> 99.95 and asked for SLA credits in section 6.2.

morgan-legal: We can accept 99.95 for Enterprise deals with a dedicated SLA appendix and adjusted credits. I'll prepare an SLA appendix and add a clause for rollback/fallback if model behavior regresses. On signer mapping: suggest two options — (A) parent signs and provides a letter of authority, or (B) subsidiary signs plus corporate resolution.

sam-engineering: Reminder: if customer requires Private deployment or VPC with KMS we need infra + KMS details before onboarding. That can block activation until security ops completes review. Security questionnaire items flagged: data residency, key management, subprocessor list.

elaine-sales: Action items: 1) Morgan: draft delegation language and SLA appendix 2) Finance: finish credit check and share EIN requirement 3) Kai: confirm DocuSign flow for multi-entity signing and estimate time delta 4) Sam: confirm infra/security prerequisites and whether they impact go-live. I'll hold signature until those are clear. :white_check_mark:

morgan-legal: Ack — I'll draft the appendix and proposed signer delegation language (corporate resolution template) and post here by EOD.

kai-ops: If they insist on multiple signers, I'll prepare an envelope template with signer roles and email mapping. Heads-up: DocuSign verification sometimes flags EU subsidiaries and we may need additional vendor verification which adds ~3 business days.

jordan-finance: Credit OK pending EIN. If they switch signer to the parent entity, we can waive the extended-terms fee. Also FYI — Net60 will shift the payment calendar to next billing cycle.

elaine-sales: Thanks all. I'll ask the customer for EIN, corporate resolution (if using subsidiary signer), and billing contact. Will update this thread when they send docs. Appreciate the quick help :pray:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reference doc uploaded to internal sales docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sales/docs/1749002468-orderflow-reference
